fact: CAPMAS released the Statistical Yearbook 2023 (issue no. 114) in January 2024, compiled with ministries and authorities, covering education, health, external and internal trade, finance and banks, transport; with the 2024 edition (115th, January 2025) this is two yearbook editions since October 2023, the underlying records not named.
title: CAPMAS Statistical Yearbook issues No. 114 of 2023
